record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: Is every smooth Fano threefold X with Picard number rho(X) = 1 K-semistable?

evidence.quote: Problem 10. Any smooth Fano threefold X with ρ(X) = 1 is K-semistable.

artifact.self_contained_problem: A smooth Fano threefold is a smooth complex projective variety $X$ of dimension $3$ whose anticanonical divisor $-K_X$ is ample. Its Picard number $\rho(X)$ is the rank of the Picard group $\mathrm{Pic}(X)$. Recall that $X$ is said to be K-semistable if for every test configuration $(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{L})$ of $(X,-K_X)$ the generalized Futaki invariant (equivalently, the Donaldson–Futaki invariant) satisfies $\mathrm{Fut}(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{L}) \geq 0$.\n\nProve or disprove: every smooth Fano threefold $X$ with Picard number $\rho(X) = 1$ is K-semistable.
artifact.status_search_result: K-stability of smooth Fano threefolds with Picard number 1 (the "prime" Fano threefolds) is an active area of research. Although individual deformation families have been substantially analyzed, no complete classification of K-(semi)stable members exists for all such families, and recent literature (e.g., on K-moduli of prime Fano threefolds of genus twelve, 2025–2026) explicitly states that K-moduli boundaries are not described for any family of prime Fano threefolds. The conjecture that every such smooth threefold is K-semistable remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: The boundary of K-moduli of prime Fano threefolds of genus twelve
status_evidence.snippet: Relatively few results are known about K-moduli of prime Fano threefolds... a description of the boundary of the K-moduli space is known for no family of prime Fano threefolds.
status_evidence.claim: K-stability/K-moduli of smooth prime (Picard rank one) Fano threefolds is incompletely understood, with major aspects still open.

status_evidence.title: The Calabi Problem for Fano Threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on K-stability of smooth Fano threefolds across all 105 deformation families.
status_evidence.claim: K-(semi)stability is studied family-by-family; no uniform proof for all Picard rank one smooth Fano threefolds is recorded.
